outcome: oxygenation (Oxygen Index (OI), alveolar-arterial oxygen difference (AaDO2), oxygen saturation (SpO2))
cohort: Forty neonates diagnosed with persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) at a median gestation of 38 weeks, who received oral bosentan as adjunctive therapy.
finding: Oral bosentan therapy significantly improved oxygenation parameters (OI, AaDO2, SpO2) within 2 hours of treatment in neonates with PPHN, with no significant changes in blood pressure, and was associated with a 12.5% mortality rate.
